description: This file defines API routes for user authentication, including signup and login functionalities, using FastAPI. It handles user creation with hashed passwords, login validation, and JWT token generation, interfacing with a database via SQLAlchemy ORM models and sessions.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router object handling API endpoints for authentication.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: Schema for error responses in API.

classes.name: AuthResponse
classes.description: Schema for authentication response, including JWT token and user info.

classes.name: User
classes.description: SQLAlchemy ORM model representing a user in the database.

methods.name: AuthResponse signup(payload: SignupRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user, hash their password, save to database, and return a JWT token.

methods.name: AuthResponse login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to authenticate a user with email and password, returning a JWT token upon success.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^def login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> AuthResponse:$/

ctags.name: signup
ctags.pattern: /^def signup(payload: SignupRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> AuthResponse:$/
